issue.body:
This fixes issue #9410 and reduce error logging while trying to connect to Cassandra database at container startup (as discussed in https://github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-java/issues/9337#issuecomment-2407377055).

The proposed solution introduces a method `withSslClientConfig(certFile, keyFile)` to use when a secured connection (TLS) is required by the Cassandra server configuration. It allows to specify the client certificate and key to use when connection checks and init script execution are performed.

The tests and documentation have been updated as well.
